## Question
Which rooftop retrofits should be prioritized for solar development?

## Answer
Property 42204 [E62] (Echelon at Television Center) is the top-ranked candidate with a usable roof area of 25,203 [E62] sq ft, estimated capacity of 302.4 [E62] kW, annual energy production of 488,744 [E62] kWh, and a simple payback of 5.6 [E62] years.

## Ranking

| Rank | Property id | Usable roof area (sq ft) | Capacity (kW) | Annual energy (kWh) | Payback (years) |
|------|-------------|--------------------------|----------------|---------------------|-----------------|
| 1 | 42204 [E62] | 25,203 [E62] | 302.4 [E62] | 488,744 [E62] | 5.6 [E62] |

## Assumptions

The modeling used a usable fraction of roof of 0.45 [E62], a photovoltaic density of 12.0 [E62] watts per usable sq ft, an installed cost of $2.00 [E62] per watt, electricity price of $0.22 [E62] per kWh, array tilt of 10 [E62] degrees, azimuth of 180 [E62] degrees, and system losses of 14 [E62] percent. Energy estimates came from NREL PVWatts v8 [E62].

## Caveats

Simple payback ignores incentives, financing, degradation, demand charges, operations and maintenance costs, and tax incentives [E62]. Roof area is measured from aerial imagery and may include roof areas that cannot hold panels [E62]. The sample included 15 [E1] buildings scanned, with 0 [E62] skipped for having no measured roof area. Property 246824 [E62] at Rank 8 [E62] shows existing solar panels in the aerial image [E45].

The top-ranked outreach draft for Property 42204 [E76] (Rank 1 [E62] of 1–10 [E62]) is available for human review and was not sent.
